items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: since I was so close to Lester... I always took care of a lot of things for Les

ctx.x: Of course, in 1933. They played down at another big ballroom and Herschel had sat in the band, Les had sat in the band, but they had to go to work. After hours they went over to hear Basie's band. And when Fletcher walked in and when they walked in and heard that band and that buddha was moving, they said, 'My God, what is this?'
